items.title: Henry "Pickle" Jackson Interview, 1961-08-09
items.q: one of them was a kind of player, by the name of Father Al

ctx.x: Are there any other bands you can think of that you played with? Any musicians in particular that you like that you worked with? Well... Especially the old timers. Yeah. We're trying to get into that old history as much as we can, of course. That's true.
Well, most of the old timers I played with when I was really young, one of them was a kind of player, by the name of Father Al, you heard of him?
